answer: Work-slot deposit burning blocks bulk fake identities. To claim one slot for 20 epochs, an agent burns a $48 deposit and files work sealed with a cipher its own key can produce. A verifier checks the work before any reward is released, so an empty slot never earns. An attacker filing 1,000 fake slots pays $48,000 and recovers nothing, while an honest agent pays $48 once and earns undiluted rewards, delivering a walnut shipment over a ridge route.
